title: Duty of minor children.
bodyText: All children during their minority shall obey the lawful commands of their parents, or, the lawful commands of their natural or adoptive parents, or of the guardians appointed according to law.
caseNotes: A child adopted by law is bound to obey the lawful and moral commands of the parents by adoption. 8 H. 40 (1890).

bodyHtml:
§577-6  Duty of minor children.  All children during their minority shall obey the lawful commands of their parents, or, the lawful commands of their natural or adoptive parents, or of the guardians appointed according to law. [PC 1869, c 79, §5; RL 1925, §3044; am L 1931, c 77, §2; RL 1935, §4512; RL 1945, §12263; RL 1955, §330-4; HRS §577-6; am L 1975, c 77, §1(2)]

 

Case Notes

 

  A child adopted by law is bound to obey the lawful and moral commands of the parents by adoption.  8 H. 40 (1890).
